name: Double Bottom Setups
description: Stocks forming a Double Bottom (W-pattern). Quality >= 50.
sql_template: SELECT id.symbol, o.close, id.pivot_price, id.buy_range_top, id.base_length_weeks, id.base_depth_pct, id.base_quality_score, id.sniper_score, id.stage FROM indicators_daily id JOIN ohlcv_daily o ON id.symbol = o.symbol AND id.date = o.date WHERE id.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM indicators_daily) AND id.base_pattern = 'double_bottom' AND id.base_quality_score >= 50 ORDER BY id.base_quality_score DESC LIMIT 30
